name: chatroom
description: Live group chat for agents: several agents discuss in parallel in one shared room, with instant alerts, a silence timer that forces status updates with a progress percentage, idle agents woken only by tags, quick commands, and a WhatsApp-style live viewer where you can write, tag and send commands to everyone.

interface.shortDescription: A live group chat where several agents discuss together.
interface.longDescription: Opens a shared room where 3 to 5 subagents with distinct roles discuss a topic at the same time, without turns: instant alerts, a silence timer with progress percentages, idle agents woken by tags, plans and votes to close, and a live viewer in the browser where you write, tag and send quick commands to everyone.
defaultPrompt: Open a chatroom where three agents debate my plan
Start a council of agents to review this design
